title: 147872137 - 42-t-26444785-20060476F-001-002-2013
doc_notes: This document is a collection of emails and attachments regarding UFO-related claims, including the Roswell incident, astronaut sightings, and government conspiracy theories, which the government records without endorsement.

encounters.summary: Mortician Glenn Dennis reported being contacted by a base mortuary officer regarding bodies of non-human entities, and later meeting a nurse who described the bodies.
encounters.entity_appearance: noses didn't protrude, eyes set deep, ears were little indentations, upper arm longer than lower, four tentacles instead of thumbs
encounters.quote: Their noses didn't protrude, the eyes were set pretty deep, and the ears were just little indentations

encounters.summary: Milton William Cooper claims to have witnessed a massive saucer-shaped craft emerge from the water and return to it while serving on the USS Tyroot.
encounters.quote: I saw a craft, saucer-shaped, the size of a Midway class carrier

encounters.summary: Astronaut Gordon Cooper reported a glowing, greenish object approaching his capsule, which was tracked by radar.
encounters.quote: reported a glowing, greenish object quickly approaching the capsule

encounters.summary: Report of a triangular object following a car and an orange light causing tremors near a house in Michigan.
encounters.quote: triangular shaped object following her car
